games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.description: A full PC port built on the Ocarina of Time decompilation, with widescreen, high frame rates, an extensive enhancements menu and a randomizer.

titles: Legend of Zelda, The - Ocarina of Time
Legend of Zelda, The - Ocarina of Time - Master Quest
rom.note: Accepts several N64 and GameCube versions. If yours isn't supported, the game says so during setup.
rom.firstRun: On first launch the game finds your ROM and extracts its assets. Answer Yes to the extraction prompt, and No to the Master Quest prompt unless you have that disc.

boxart: Legend of Zelda, The - Ocarina of Time (USA)
Legend of Zelda, The - Ocarina of Time (USA) (Rev 2)

games.about: Released in November 1998, Ocarina of Time took Link into 3D and introduced Z-targeting and context-sensitive controls. It is regularly named one of the greatest games ever made.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask

titles: Legend of Zelda, The - Majora's Mask
rom.note: Needs the North American N64 version.
rom.firstRun: On first launch the game finds your ROM and extracts its assets (one time only).

boxart: Legend of Zelda, The - Majora's Mask (USA)

games.about: The 2000 follow-up to Ocarina of Time, built on the same engine in under two years. Link has three days to stop the moon falling on Termina, and keeps rewinding them with the Song of Time. On the N64 it needed the Expansion Pak.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
games.description: Majora's Mask statically recompiled to native code, with ray-traced-style RT64 rendering, ultrawide support, high frame rates and a mod menu.

titles: Legend of Zelda, The - Majora's Mask
rom.note: Only the North American N64 version works.
rom.firstRun: Choose "Select ROM" in the game's main menu. Your ROM's path is on the clipboard: paste it into the file box with Ctrl+V.
rom.formatNote: The game converts .n64/.v64 to .z64 itself, as long as it's the right ROM.

boxart: Legend of Zelda, The - Majora's Mask (USA)

games.title: Perfect Dark
games.description: Rare's shooter running natively with mouse aim, high frame rates, widescreen and up to four local players.

rom.note: Use the North American "final" release (Rev 1). The original US 1.0 needs a different build.
rom.firstRun: Your ROM is already in the game's data folder. Just play.
rom.formatNote: Must be a .z64 named pd.ntsc-final.z64 in the game's data folder. Cartridge converts and places it for you.

games.about: Rare's 2000 follow-up to GoldenEye 007, starring agent Joanna Dark. Most of the game needed the Expansion Pak, and it pushed the N64 so hard that it often ran at low frame rates, which the PC port fixes.
